antenna: Exact model, attachment and orientation unverified; no physical intervention
demodulator: Mix channel offset; 255-tap 90 kHz lowpass; decimate4; quadrature phase difference; discard100ms; peak normalize to30000 PCM
raw_publication: IQ/MPX kept private in ignored scratch; decoded public broadcast metadata only

decode_summary.count_scope: Emitted groups only; unsynchronized/omitted groups excluded. PI field can be inherited; direct PI counts use raw block A only.
decode_summary.checkword_policy: redsea --no-fec; no burst correction; valid blocks have expected syndrome/offset. This is RDS 10-bit checkword evidence, not a separate external CRC verifier.
